data.understanding: The Cleanup V2 change overloaded config.SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES with eight source-content languages even though that constant is consumed as the operator UI language allowlist. This makes Settings offer untranslated languages and causes persisted fr to bypass the established self-heal to en. Restore SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES to en and ro, introduce a distinct Cleanup source-language constant for en, ro, de, fr, ru, pt, es and it, and correct the durable contracts without changing Cleanup script eligibility or AI translation target options.
